page.content:
Spin-off films that send the Mane Six through a mirror as human teens.

How My Little Pony: Equestria Girls connects

  • Character: Sunset Shimmer — Sunset Shimmer is the redeemed lead of the Equestria Girls films.
  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Equestria Girls spins the Mane Six into a human-world film series.

What is My Little Pony: Equestria Girls?

Equestria Girls is the high-school spin-off in which Twilight, Sunset Shimmer, and the rest of the Mane Six cross a magic mirror into a human world that still runs on friendship magic.

Key threads lead to Sunset Shimmer and My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic.
